NVIDIA’s JUPITER initiative reached a milestone with a 104‑qubit simulation that highlighted GPU‑based supercomputers as a viable design platform for fault‑tolerant quantum computing. The study leveraged H100 GPUs to execute large‑scale tensor operations associated with quantum error correction, demonstrating performance scalability needed for future quantum hardware development. This work underscores the role of advanced GPUs in accelerating the prototype and validation phases of next‑generation quantum systems.
